role: PIXL specialist pixel-art assessment of the delivered Ready sample and its art direction (handoff-repair stage, PHASE.md). Assessment only: it creates no acceptance evidence, no PX2 verdict, and no family approval.

artifact.provenance: Controlled evaluator fixture served by the pixellab-test connection for job controlled-create-0002 (provider_simulated=true). The PNG tEXt chunk reads 'purpose: Controlled retrieval fixture, not PixelLab-generated art'. Not upstream PixelLab generation.

coordinate_convention: Zero-based (x, y) with x to the right and y downward; boxes are [left, top, right, bottom] with exclusive right/bottom (pixl_asset_check convention). Pixel-map rows below list y then the 16 columns x = 0..15; '#' is alpha 255, '.' is alpha 0.

tools: Selected Python -I with Pillow (decode, pixel map, column runs, mass centre, WCAG-style luminance ratio, 3x block uniformity)

arm_partition_by_column.note: Partition is by column relative to the lowest vertex column (x=6). It is a reproducible measurement of asymmetry, not a required ratio.

arm_direction.left_arm: descends left-to-right from (3,9)/(4,8) to the vertex at (6,12); 3 column steps
arm_direction.right_arm: ascends left-to-right from the vertex (6,12) to the tip at (12,4)/(13,5); 7 column steps
arm_direction.stair_step: Both arms shift exactly one row per column (regular 45-degree staircase); each interior column has a contiguous 3-pixel vertical run.

measured.end_caps: Single-pixel tapered caps at (3,9) [left tip], (12,4) and (13,5) [top-right tip, a 2-pixel chevron], and (6,12) [bottom vertex]. These are the thinnest features (1 device pixel at 1x, 3x3 at 3x).

contrast_diagnostic.scope: Diagnostic computed from sRGB relative luminance. It supports the 1x readability observation; it is not a rejection rule and proves no aesthetic quality (silhouette-readability pitfalls).

integer_presentation_check.method: integer-presentation: each logical pixel expands to a uniform 3x3 block and no new colours appear (29 x 9 = 261 blue device pixels).

start_vector_comparison.note: Start (vector) covers roughly twice the area of Ready. Start is preserved by the brief; the weight difference is a pre-existing condition, not a Ready defect.

observations: The mark reads immediately as a check mark: a short descending arm meeting a long ascending arm at a low-left vertex. Asymmetry is obvious at both 1x and 3x; no second glance is needed.
On #172336 at 1x the light sky-blue mark is clearly legible; the single-pixel tips are faint but present and do not carry identity (identity is carried by the two arms and the vertex).
At 3x nearest the diagonal edges are crisp regular staircases; no blur, no intermediate colours, no stray pixels, no halo.
The mark sits optically centred: bbox centre is the cell centre and the mass centre is only 0.24 px low, which is appropriate for a check whose vertex hangs below the midline.
There is no backing plate or outline; the silhouette is the whole subject (transparent exterior), consistent with the flat, plate-less Start triangle.
visually_inspected.viewing_limits: Viewed through the host's image display at the retained native and 3x view sizes; no graphical renderer, no actual UI panel capture, and no display-DPR check were available. Image-level observation only.

expert_reasoning.criterion_coverage_as_observation: Against the corrected criteria the delivered bytes satisfy geometry, transparent-background, ready-meaning, readability-1x-3x, cool-blue-accent and sample-pixel-craft by measurement and viewing. This is a specialist observation recorded here; it is not a new verdict and does not alter the historical ready.delivery.review verdicts.

silhouette.finding: Identity landmarks (two unequal arms, low vertex, open upper-left negative space) remain visible at the target 16px size on the actual dark panel. The open upper-left region is what distinguishes a check from a triangle or chevron and it stays open at 1x. Silhouette alone does not validate aesthetics; it does establish that meaning is carried by form, which also helps the future non-colour family distinctions.

edge_rhythm.finding: Both arms are declared-straight 45-degree diagonals with a perfectly repeating one-row-per-column step and 3-pixel vertical runs. The only run-length changes are the four end caps, which are intentional tapers, not jaggies. No cleanup is indicated.

expert_reasoning.stroke_and_cluster: Vertical run of 3 at 45 degrees gives a perpendicular stroke of about 2.1 px, which reads as a medium-weight stroke at 16px and as bold at 3x. The 29-pixel cluster is a single 4-connected component (semantic cluster = raster cluster), so there is no hidden fragmentation risk under nearest scaling.

colour.finding: One flat colour equal to the Start SVG fill. The brief names the cool blue as an accent role and leaves palette open; using it as the sole fill is the specialist's extent choice for a flat-glyph family. It is coherent with the one existing asset (a flat #70b9ed vector) and gives a neutral baseline for later ramp or highlight experiments.
colour.expert_choice_vs_owner_requirement: Owner requirement: the existing cool blue accent is used and its relationship to the UI is perceptible (BRIEF.md line 3). Expert choice: cool blue as the dominant/only colour of the mark, and the exact value #70b9ed. A mostly neutral mark with a clear blue accent would also satisfy the owner; the historical 'dominant' clause was therefore an extent proposal, not a requirement (PROFILE 'Visual roles'), and is demoted in the corrected plan.

alpha.finding: Observed alpha is binary (0/255) with straight alpha semantics implied by the PNG. The brief permits partial alpha; binary alpha here is an observation, not a requirement, and a later family member may use authored partial alpha on edges if the style decision adopts it. Transparent-pixel RGB is (0,0,0), which is harmless under straight alpha.

integer_presentation.finding: The retained 3x view demonstrates uniform 3x3 expansion with no new colours. The real renderer (display.scale 3, filter nearest) is not supplied, so this proves the inspection view, not the product UI.

possible_refinements_not_defects: The single-pixel tapered tips are the weakest feature at 1x. A 2-pixel blunt cap would be sturdier but heavier and less elegant; at 7.4:1 contrast the tapers remain visible. Keep as is unless the style review prefers blunt caps for the whole family.

Ready is visually lighter than the preserved Start triangle (29 px vs ~60 px area). This is acceptable for a status glyph beside a control, but Working, Retry and Paused should land in a similar weight band to Ready (roughly 25-40 opaque px) so the status row has even rhythm; Start remains the heavier control by design.

family_extension_guidance.status: proposal; depends on the owner/caller style decision (BRIEF.md line 5) which has not been made

shared_grammar_proposed.canvas: 16x16, transparent exterior, no plate (unless the style decision adds one for all members)
shared_grammar_proposed.stroke: about 3-row diagonal runs / 2-3 px orthogonal strokes, matching Ready
shared_grammar_proposed.caps: tapered single-pixel caps on diagonals, square caps on orthogonals; choose one family-wide
shared_grammar_proposed.colour: flat #70b9ed-family cool blue as the primary fill; a second lighter or darker blue only if adopted for all members
shared_grammar_proposed.weight: 25-40 opaque pixels per frame, bbox about 9-11 px, optically centred
shared_grammar_proposed.non_colour_identity: each member must be a distinct form in grayscale: diagonal V (Ready), rotational segments (Working), curved arrow with head (Retry), two vertical bars (Paused)

working.proposal: Four 16x16 frames in a 64x16 horizontal strip at 100 ms (BRIEF.md line 3; queue-view frames 4, frameMs 100). A rotating three-segment arc or orbiting dots in the same stroke weight; every frame must avoid a check-like V or a filled terminal pose, so the loop never resembles Ready. The animation is driven by the running state only; no decorative timer implying progress. Verify loop closure frame 4 -> frame 1 and stable placement (animation-anchors).

retry.proposal: A circular/return arrow with a clear arrow head, static, at assets/error-retry.png. Form (curve plus head) distinguishes it from the check in grayscale, satisfying 'distinguishable without color alone' (BRIEF.md line 3) regardless of hue choice. Keep the head at least 3 px so it survives 1x.

paused.proposal: Two vertical 3-px bars with a 2-px gap, static, at assets/paused.png. Vertical orthogonal bars are distinct in grayscale from the diagonal check, the rotational Working forms and the curved Retry arrow (BRIEF.md line 7).

family_extension_guidance.collective_review: Compare all members in one row at 1x and 3x on #172336 and in a grayscale copy before adoption; bind the approved Ready bytes as the style reference source in PLAR.

limitations: Fixture provenance: the image is a controlled evaluator fixture, not upstream PixelLab generation; nothing here is evidence about PixelLab output quality.
No graphical renderer was supplied; statusCell/compactStatus were executed as modules only (integration-recheck.json). Actual alpha compositing, DPR and layout in the product UI are unverified.
No Working, Retry or Paused art exists; extensibility is a judgement about the Ready treatment, not a family comparison.
Measured values are exact for the cited bytes; viewing was through the host image display at small sizes.
The WCAG-style ratio is a diagnostic, not an adopted rule.
knowledge_methods_cited: animation-anchors (referenced for the Working loop-closure check)
